items.sentence: Heavy traffic on the map shows where most cars enter town.
The major road through our town has four wide lanes.
This bus route reaches three villages beyond the river.
Commuters rush toward the platform when the bell rings.
One small electric vehicle carries mail around the campus.
Trains transport apples from mountain farms to the coastal city.
Drivers utilize the new tunnel to save fifteen minutes.
One remote island receives mail by boat twice each month.
Deer sometimes leap over the low fence beside the highway.
Old pipes leak water onto the sidewalk every rainy week.
